name: Weighted Adam Optimizer
definition:
An optimization update rule that modifies the standard Adam algorithm by weighting the gradient and momentum terms with a scalar weight $ ar{
u}_i 	imes [0,1]$ representing the average visibility or informativeness of the gradient for iteration $i$. This prevents divergence when primitives are obscured or have many keyframes.
summary: Weighted Adam modulates gradient updates using visibility weights to prevent divergence from obscured parameters, replacing fixed bias correction with accumulated visibility-weighted counters.
